methods.method-0000: Apply method and coding before any body limit or profile; failed prefixes and failed profiles leave the supplied state unchanged.
methods.method-0001: Encode the chosen request line and headers with CRLF, calculate any content length and append the exact body bytes.
methods.method-0002: Apply the address limit after method/coding and before reading the body, then scan the body and check device_name first.
methods.method-0003: Select exactly one unambiguous credential form by header and server-cookie occurrence count before validating it.
methods.method-0004: Apply startup/method first, reject ambiguous forms, ignore unrelated cookies and validate only the selected credential.
methods.method-0005: Rejected opens change no identifier entry or stream owner; accepted opens reuse an existing owner/client key even at capacity.
methods.method-0006: Apply verifier availability, permitted scheme, allowed endpoint and stop state in specification order before credentials or connection.
methods.method-0007: Validate both URLs first, then verifier, scheme, destination and stop state; an otherwise valid new connection completes credential-free discovery.
methods.method-0008: After static preflight, establish a credential-free connection and require authenticated ticket provenance before reading or transferring its credential.
methods.method-0009: Different resolved names select the same oneof member, so occurrence check 3 precedes the second value type check.
methods.method-0010: Identify the declaring schema field of the failed check; apply the explicit local-diagnostic naming rule.
